headline: Gratitude Jar
tagline: Fill it up with thankful thoughts

scenes.title: Rainbow Confetti Lid
tips: Draw or write inside the jar
scenes.say: Little ones can fill the big open jar with drawings before they can even write.

scenes.title: Classroom Doodle Jar
scenes.say: Add one thankful thought per line during morning circle, and watch the jar fill up.

scenes.title: Botanical Apothecary Jar
scenes.say: Keep this calm page by your bed and add one small gratitude every evening.

scenes.title: Split Jar: Words + Sketch
tips: A tiny sketch on the other
scenes.say: Write a few words on one side, then sketch the same moment on the other.

scenes.title: Speech Bubble Pantry Jar
tips: Fill each bubble with a win
scenes.say: Turn each speech bubble into a quick win from the week, big or small.

scenes.title: Heart Bubble Mason Jar
scenes.say: Put one thank-you in each heart, then color them in once the jar is full.

scenes.title: Ocean Tide Jar
scenes.say: Pass it around the Thanksgiving table so everyone adds something before dessert.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Many come in color and B&W
tips.say: Print one page per person, and grab the black and white versions to save ink.

say.title: Free printable gratitude jars to fill with thankful thoughts this season.
say.hook: Grab a pen or some crayons, and fill the jar with thanks.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
